description: Git with a cup of tea! Painless self-hosted all-in-one software development service, including Git hosting, code review, team collaboration, package registry and CI/CD.

promotion.reason: Approved by the owner. The Runtipi definition runs Gitea 1.27.3 and PostgreSQL 14. A September 30 managed-Windows proof created a private repository and exact committed file, verified the commit after restart and keep-data reinstall, and removed its owned resources. Reviewed storage pins move both POSIX-sensitive mounts into Docker named volumes.

data_storage: Docker named volumes for Gitea data and PostgreSQL
risk_notes: Creates 2 Docker containers and publishes 2 ports on this computer's loopback interface only.
Its gitea service answers on a second loopback address, which the app's own pages call directly. Local Store opens only the main one.
Keeps Git files and PostgreSQL in Docker named volumes. A keep-data uninstall retains both; deleting data removes both.
Proven on Windows with Docker's Linux engine. macOS and Linux hosts are unverified.
Opens an installer page: check the settings it shows, then create the administrator account.
Serves git over HTTP on its own address, and over SSH on a second loopback address — both reachable from this computer only.
Registration is open until you turn it off in its settings.

storage_pins.reason: Git configuration and SSH host keys require POSIX file permissions, which a Windows-backed WSL bind mount cannot provide.
PostgreSQL initialization needs POSIX chmod and ownership, which a Windows-backed WSL bind mount cannot provide.
